Vasakul servas ja ülal helesinine, õrnade valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas. Vasakult langev päike kuldab puud heki taga ning jätab hekivarju paremal päikeses murule.
1400.de: The picture shows a section of the old town's green area: in the foreground a hillside covered with grass, with bushes in the foreground. In the middle a piece of the town wall, transformed as if into a trimmed hedge, behind which trees. On the left edge and above, a light blue sky covered with delicate white clouds. The sun, falling from the left, gilds the trees behind the hedge and casts the hedge's shadow on the sunlit grass on the right.

The installation includes an old aluminium bowl, in which, during exhibition, 1-2 tongues specially cast for the purpose soak.

1442.d: Neli poolalasti naist istumas antiikesemetega kaunistatud ruumis (stuudios). Naiste ülakeha on paljas, nad on rikkalikult ehitud, alakehasid katab kangatükk. Kujutis on must-valge, fotolaadne. Maali esiplaanil all punase-valgeruudulise linaga kaetud laud, millele asetatud ümaraid, läikiva pinnaga esemeid. Maali must-valgel osal pealemaalitud kraklee- või murdejoonte imitatsioon.
1442.de: Four half-naked women seated in a room (studio) decorated with antique objects. The women's upper bodies are bare, they are richly adorned, their lower bodies covered by a piece of cloth. The image is black and white, photo-like. In the foreground of the painting, below, a table covered with a red-and-white checked cloth, on which round objects with a shiny surface are placed. On the black-and-white part of the painting, an imitation of craquelure or crack lines has been painted on.

1487.dm: kõrgus: 81.0 cm (III osa   ); kõrgus: 243.0 cm (II osa    ); laius: 70.0 cm (I osa   ); laius: 70.0 cm (III osa   )
1487.d: Kolmest osast koosnev kompositsioon, mille fooni moodustab seeriatena antud reklaamtrükised kõrrega jooki imevast naisest ja poisist ning Tallinna vaadetest. Keskmisele osale on kruvitud neli punase puunupuga nagi ning 8 väikest alumiiniumist keeksivormi, keskkosa vertikaalsest keskteljest paremale on pildi pinnale kinnitatud pikad keerduvad plekklindid. Trükistega kaetud foon pildi kesktahvlil osaliselt kaetud vasakul musta, paremal ekspressiivselt musta, valge ja punase värviga. Parempoolsel osal ülal musta ja kollasega tõmmatud laiad pintslilöögid.
1487.de: A composition consisting of three parts, the background of which is formed by advertising prints given in series of a woman and a boy sipping a drink through a straw, and views of Tallinn. Four red wooden-knobbed coat hooks and 8 small aluminium cake tins are screwed onto the middle part; to the right of the vertical central axis of the middle section, long twisting sheet-metal strips are attached to the surface of the picture. The background covered with prints on the central panel of the picture is partially covered on the left with black, on the right expressively with black, white and red paint. On the right-hand part, above, broad brushstrokes drawn in black and yellow.

1512.d: Apelsinikarva foonil, mis all paremas nurgas läheb üle rohekashalliks, on vasemas ülemises neljandikus kaks suurt nelinurka. Neist vasakpoolne kollakashall ja parempoolne hallikassinine.
1512.de: On an orange-coloured background, which in the lower right corner turns into greenish-grey, there are two large quadrangles in the upper left quarter. Of these the left one is yellowish-grey and the right one is greyish-blue.

1513.d: Suurtest helesinistest pindadest kujundatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Vasakus ülemises nurgas kollakas kuma.
1513.de: Abstract composition formed of large light-blue areas. In the upper left corner a yellowish glow.

1525.d: Vanadest maalitud lõuenditest kokku õmmeldud alusel värvinirede ja spaatliga maalitud mitmekihiline abstraktne kompositsioon. Valdavalt valge - musta - sinise kombinatsioonis. Vasak alumine osa sinkjasmust maaliline nelinurkne pind. Maali ülemine ja parem alumine pool määrdunud valgega spaatlitõmmetega maalitud. All keskel aerograafiga kirjutatud hall kiri: POVERTY STINKS, all paremal pastoosselt maalipinnas: FOR EVER AND EVER.
1525.de: A multilayered abstract composition on a base sewn together from old painted canvases, painted with dripped paint and a spatula. Predominantly in a combination of white - black - blue. The lower left part is a bluish-black painterly rectangular surface. The upper and lower right half of the painting are painted with soiled white spatula strokes. At bottom centre, written with an airbrush, grey text: POVERTY STINKS, at bottom right, painted impasto in the paint surface: FOR EVER AND EVER.

1586.de: A two-part composition. Tar paper and a rusted sheet-metal base (upper left, lower right) fastened to a robust upright wooden frame, on which a swastika-like propeller shape composed of two bent arms and two legs is marked in white paint. The background is painted in silver, bronze and reddish colour. A saw blade is fastened between the two parts.

1598.dm: aeg/ kestus: 44.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 10.0 minut
1598.d: Teos koosnes kahest osast: a) klaaskuubi ujutamine aprillist oktoobrini 1994 (aktsioonid, performance'id); b) video-installatsioon Brasiilias, Sâo Paulo biennaalil. Dokumentaalvideo kujutab suure peeglitest kuubi ujutamist Emajõel ja Vltava jõel, Prahas. Klaaskuup reflekteerib vett, taevast, möödavilksatavaid puid, inimesi, kaarsildu.
1598.de: The work consisted of two parts: a) floating a glass cube from April to October 1994 (actions, performances); b) a video installation in Brazil, at the São Paulo Biennial. The documentary video depicts the floating of a large mirrored cube on the Emajõgi River and the Vltava River in Prague. The glass cube reflects water, sky, flashing trees, people, arched bridges.

1599.dm: aeg/ kestus: 35.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 2.0 minut
1599.d: Kunstnik uisutab alasti üle jäätunud mere. Ta teeb oma 10-aastase poja koraalilaulu saatel mitu ringi ümber vaataja, kuni uisutab tagasi sinna kust ta tuli, kadudes valgesse olematusse. Esmakordselt eksponeeriti 1998. a personaalnäitusel Tallinnas Linnagaleriis
1599.de: The artist skates naked across the frozen sea. Accompanied by his 10-year-old son's chorale singing, he makes several circles around the viewer, until he skates back to where he came from, disappearing into white nothingness. First exhibited at his 1998 solo exhibition at the Tallinn City Gallery.

1605.d: Kahvatutes toonides alasti meesfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, pea vasakule. Vasakus käes kirves, parema käe kohal tiivataoline kujutis. Mees suure kala taustal-seljas. Kujundid ümbritsetud laiade värviliste kontuurjoontega.
1605.de: In pale tones a nude male figure in a three-quarter turn to the right, head to the left. In his left hand an axe, above his right hand a wing-like image. The man against the background of, and on the back of, a large fish. The figures are surrounded by broad coloured contour lines.

1607.d: Heledaks krunditud pinnal savi, orgaaniline aine ja värvi pritsmeid, hõõrutud mööda alust. Pastoosne moodustis rohust, savist, ograanilisest materjalist ja liimainest kompositsiooni vasakul ülemises kolmandikus kinnitatud pinnale kruvidega.
1607.de: On a lightly primed surface, clay, organic matter and splashes of paint, rubbed over the base. A pasty formation of grass, clay, organic material and adhesive substance fixed to the surface with screws in the upper left third of the composition.

1608.d: Heledale pinnale määritud, hõõrutud orgaaniline aine, kinnitatud liimainega (?), pastoosseid ruumilisi moodustisi savist, sõnnikust, õlgedest, kuivanud rohust.
1608.de: Organic matter smeared and rubbed onto a light-coloured surface, attached with an adhesive (?), pasty spatial formations of clay, dung, straw, dried grass.

1610.dm: aeg/ kestus: 45.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 31.0 minut

1611.de: 20 computer monitors arranged in a circle, on the screens of which a rhythmic play of colour and form synchronised with sound.

1612.de: The installation consists of two cuboids to be hung on the wall, both with an upper part of window panes with light blue frames and dirty glass, and a lower part evenly covered with dried plants, on which a purple trapezoid is painted.

1692.d: Dekoratiivne autoukse kujutis auto seestpoolt vaadatuna. Valgel taustal paksude mustade ümardatud kontuuridega markeeritud ukse üldkuju, akna sulgur, hinged, ukse käepide, aknalink, sisetasku, millest paistab ajakirja nurk kirjaga: NEW SP(EED). Ukse polster ühtlaselt helesinist tooni. Värvid kantud valmis kujundite järgi tagantpoolt. Töö ülal paremal mustaga kiri: "UKS"
1692.de: A decorative depiction of a car door viewed from inside the car. The overall shape of the door, marked on a white background with thick black rounded contours, the window latch, hinges, door handle, window crank, inner pocket, from which the corner of a magazine is visible with the text: NEW SP(EED). The door upholstery is a uniform light blue tone. The colours are applied from behind according to ready-made shapes. At the top right of the work, in black: "UKS"

1693.d: Mustal taustal dekoratiivselt kujutatud auto armatuurlaua andurid-näiturid. Vasakul spidomeeter: kollasel poolkaarel punasega näidud 200-st 700-ni, roheline osuti sinikollases sõõris. Selle all hodomeeter näiduga 5721. Paremal tulede- ja bensiininäidik kollase, valge, punasega kujutatud. Värv kantud šablooni järgi pleksiklaasi teisele poole. Allservas valgega kiri: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"
1693.de: Against a black background, decoratively depicted car dashboard sensors-gauges. On the left a speedometer: on a yellow semicircle readings in red from 200 to 700, a green needle in a blue-yellow circle. Below it an odometer with reading 5721. On the right a lights and fuel gauge depicted in yellow, white, red. The colour is applied by stencil onto the other side of the plexiglass. At the bottom edge, in white, text: "MEASURING INSTRUMENTS"

All vasakus nurgas musta kontuurjoonega visandatud roomava lapse figuur. Ülaservas keskel, mehe kohal kaks väikest figuuri, seljad vaataja poole. Maalitud roosades ja rohelistes toonides, visandlikult, valget krunti läbi kumada lastes.

To the left of the man a reclining woman with rounded forms, bare feet, a large décolleté revealing part of her breast. In the lower left corner the figure of a crawling child sketched with a black contour line. In the upper edge, in the middle, above the man, two small figures with their backs to the viewer. Painted in pink and green tones, sketchily, letting the white ground shine through.

4302.de: Full-length portrait of an elderly man with grey hair, in a dark blue suit, standing on grass against a background of a grove of trees, in a slight turn to the right. A monocle on the left eye. Right hand in pocket, in the left a rosary with a cross hangs.

4407.d: Pildi parempoolses osas kolmest naisest koosnev figuuridegrupp: parempoolne kujutatud kaelast põlvedeni, seljas valge, kitsaste õlapaeltega suvekleit. Keskmine, kollaste punasetäpiliste juustega naine on antud profiilis, käes valge kohvitass. Vasakul, keskmise figuuri taga kirevate värvilaikude abil modelleeritud kolmas naisefiguur, näoosa kujutab endast valget laiku. Kolme esiplaanil asuva figuuri taga on aimata veel üht, siniste juustega naisekujutist. Foon vasakul helesinine.
4407.de: In the right-hand part of the picture, a group of three female figures: the right-hand one depicted from the neck to the knees, wearing a white summer dress with narrow shoulder straps. The middle woman, with yellow, red-speckled hair, is shown in profile, holding a white coffee cup. On the left, behind the middle figure, a third female figure modelled with colourful patches of colour, the facial area represented as a white patch. Behind the three figures in the foreground, another female figure with blue hair can be discerned. The background on the left is light blue.

4410.d: Kompositsioon kahest täis- ja kahest poolfiguurist valgel taustal. Keskel Kristuse alastifiguur (sini-kollase triibuline niudevöö ümber) veerandpöördes paremale käed palveks rinnal. Temast paremal külgvaates pühak hoiab Kr. pea kohal valitsusõuna. Ülal keskel kaks õnnistavat kätt ja tuvi kujutis. Maali vas. alumises neljandikus kaks poolfiguuri, neist ülal palmi kujutis. Kõikide kujutatute peade kohal hõmedased nimbused. Maal lahendatud negatiivfoto laadis halli-mustaga markeerides.
4410.de: A composition of two full and two half figures on a white background. In the centre, a nude figure of Christ (with a blue-yellow striped loincloth around the hips) in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands folded in prayer on the chest. To his right, in side view, a saint holds the orb of dominion above Christ's head. Above in the centre, two blessing hands and the image of a dove. In the lower left quarter of the painting, two half figures, above them the image of a palm. Above the heads of all the figures depicted are faint nimbuses. The painting is executed in the manner of a negative photograph, marked in grey-black.

Ülemisel poolel all, üle kogu pildi pinna ja osalt väljapoole raami ulatuvatele lõuendijuppidele maalitud pikkade roosade uimede ja tumeda seljaga kala. Kala keskelt kasvab välja alasti naisefiguur, selg kumeras, käed toetuvad küünarnukkidega kala seljale, samal ajal otsekui punast koonust emmates. Naise valge, lokkis juustega pea on antud profiilis, sinakas suu on pärani. Figuuri ümber on maalipind hoolikalt läbi maalitud, ülejäänud fooniosas valged ja sinakad pinnad. Töö alumisel poolel keskel hele, laiali sirutatud kätega aktifiguur. Peaosa etüüdlikult läbi maalitud, suu tume ja teravate piirjoontega. Naise käsivarred kasvavad a
5080.de: The work consists of two parts divided horizontally in half. On the upper half, below, painted across the entire surface of the picture and onto canvas pieces extending partly beyond the frame, a fish with long pink fins and a dark back. From the middle of the fish grows a nude female figure, back arched, hands resting with elbows on the fish's back, while at the same time seemingly embracing a red cone. The woman's head, with white, curly hair, is shown in profile, the bluish mouth wide open. Around the figure the paint surface is carefully worked through, while the rest of the background consists of white and bluish areas. In the lower half of the work, in the middle, a light-coloured nude figure with arms spread wide. The head is worked through in a sketchy manner, the mouth dark and sharply outlined. The woman's arms grow

5081.d: Kolmeosaline. Laiemal kesktahvlil oranžil taustal värviliste laiade pintslijoontega piiritletud südame kuju, milles näiliselt vana naivistlik maastikupilt öisest jõeorust jahimehega kappaval valgel hobusel jänest taga ajamas. Pildil kahel pool puudekulisside vahel jahilossid, kuupaiste langeb veele. Kitsad külgtahvlid mõlemad ülaosas oranžid pastoossed pinnad, alumistel osadel plastikust inimese siseorganite anatoomilised mudelid kirevalt abstraktselt üle maalitud. Vasakpoolsel tahvlil südame mudel roosaks toonitud.
5081.de: Three-part work. On the wider central panel, against an orange background, outlined by wide coloured brush strokes, the shape of a heart, within which is a seemingly old naivist landscape image of a nocturnal river valley with a huntsman galloping on a white horse chasing a hare. In the picture, on both sides, between the tree wings, hunting lodges, moonlight falling on the water. The narrow side panels are both orange pastose surfaces in the upper part, and in the lower parts plastic anatomical models of human internal organs, painted over in a garishly abstract manner. On the left-hand panel the heart model is tinted pink.

5168.dm: aeg/ kestus: 35.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 17.0 minut
5168.d: Pimedal maanteel sõidab suur veoauto, mille taga on valgustatud ekraan. Ekraanil jookseb film, mis näitab Ameerika? maanteeäärseid vaateid, aga päeva ajal, päikest on palju. Veoautot on filmitud selle taga sõitvast bussist. Ekraan kord kaugeneb kord läheneb, autod tulevad vastu ja sõidavad mööda. Lõpupoole minnakse ekraanile nii lähedale, et öist maanteed pole näha, ja ruttu tagasi. Lõpuks jääb eessõitev masin seisma. Toomik räägib masinas istuvate politseinikega ja siis sõidab see ära. Buss masinale ei järgne. Helitaust: nõrgalt kuuldavad bussisõitjate kommentaarid
5168.de: A large truck is driving on a dark road, with an illuminated screen at its rear. On the screen a film is running, showing roadside views of America?, but during the daytime, with plenty of sunshine. The truck has been filmed from a bus driving behind it. The screen alternately moves further away and closer, cars come towards it and pass by. Towards the end, the approach to the screen becomes so close that the night-time road is no longer visible, and then quickly pulls back. Finally, the vehicle ahead comes to a stop. Toomik talks with the policemen sitting in the vehicle and then it drives off. The bus does not follow the vehicle. Soundtrack: faintly audible comments from the bus passengers.

5391.dm: kujutise laius: 20.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.0 cm

5392.d: Sinises interjööris üksikuna seisev valge glasuurpottahi, suudmega paremale. Ahju ülaosa kaunistab antiikimitatsiooniga dekoratiivne vaas. (L. Tiitsmaa, dets 1996)(eesti)
5392.de: A single white glazed tiled stove stands in a blue interior, with its opening facing right. The upper part of the stove is decorated with a decorative vase in antique imitation style. (L. Tiitsmaa, Dec 1996)

5393.d: Lehvivate juuste ja lipsuga tüdruk hoidmas maakera ööpoti kohal, millel poolkuu ja võrdhaarne rist
5393.de: A girl with flowing hair and a tie holding a globe above a chamber pot, on which is a crescent moon and an equal-armed cross

5394.d: Vanema vuntsidega mehe portree ajaloolises kostüümis, kübara peal erinevad lilleõied
5394.de: Portrait of an older man with a moustache in historical costume, various flowers on the hat

5400.d: Otsevaates foto kägaras meesaktist taburetil. Käed ümber jalgade, nägu toetub põlvedele. Käelabadel tumedad ümmargused armid.
5400.de: Frontal photo of a crouched male nude on a stool. Arms wrapped around the legs, face resting on the knees. Dark round scars on the hands.

5638.dm: lehe laius: 89.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 62.3 cm
5638.de: Portrait of a man with a hat full of flowers

5639.dm: lehe laius: 75.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 49.2 cm
5639.de: On the sheet flower blossoms, a parrot, a cat, angels

5698.d: Abstraktne; vaarikapunased, ülalt tumedamad, valguvad, sulanduvad, pritsitud värvipinnad osaliselt katmata vineeril, looklevad pliiatsijooned läbi värvi kumamas.
5698.de: Abstract; raspberry-red, darker at the top, running, merging, sprayed patches of colour partly leaving the plywood uncovered, meandering pencil lines showing through the paint.

5699.d: Abstraktne: mustjaspunane maalipind muutub sujuvalt vasakus ülanurgas heledamaks, läbipaistvamaks. Vasakul serval pastoossed värvinired.
5699.de: Abstract: a blackish-red painted surface smoothly becomes lighter, more transparent in the upper left corner. Pastose streaks of colour along the left edge.

5700.d: Peaaegu ühtlane punakaspruun maalipind, keskel veidi heledam kaarjas osa, kohati aluspinda läbi kumav.
5700.de: An almost even reddish-brown paint surface, in the middle a slightly lighter arched area, in places the ground shining through.

5701.d: Katmata vineeril kaks ebamäärase kujuga musta värvipinda äärtelt akvarellilikult lahja aluspinda sulanduv, pritsmeid all paremas nurgas.
5701.de: On uncoated plywood, two vaguely shaped black colour surfaces blending at the edges into a thin, watercolour-like base surface, splashes in the lower right corner.

5751.d: Üksteise sisse sulanduvate kahvatute värvidega kujutatud abstraheeritud
5751.de: Abstracted forms depicted in pale colours blending into one another

5753.d: Kahest osast koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon, mille moodustavad  hieroglüüfimustrilised rohelise, sinkjaslilla, tumepunase pintslikirja vahelduvad horisontaalread samblarohelisel taustal. Maalitud laia pintsilga, voolavad värvinired moodustamas vertikaaltriipe.
5753.de: An abstract composition consisting of two parts, formed by alternating horizontal rows of hieroglyph-patterned brushwork in green, bluish-purple and dark red on a moss-green background. Painted with a broad brush, flowing streams of paint forming vertical stripes.

5754.d: Valdavalt hallikaslillas gammas mitmekihiline,erineva faktuuriga abstraktne maal, parem
5754.de: A multi-layered abstract painting predominantly in a greyish-lilac gamut, with varying texture, right

5755.d: Valdavalt hallikasrohelises gammas krobelise faktuuriga abstraktne kompositsioon.
5755.de: An abstract composition with a rough texture, predominantly in a greyish-green range.

6000.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest ja maastikumotiividest poolabstraktne kompositsioon: vasakul ülal kaarsilda meenutav objekt kauge sinkjasrohelise maastiku taustal. Paremal roosad, rohelised, mustad värvid, ülal maalilisemad pinnad. Maali alumine osa valdavalt valkjates ja summutatud gammas selgepiirilistest geomeetrilistest enamasti teravnurksetest pindadest koosnev.
6000.de: A semi-abstract composition of geometric shapes and landscape motifs: upper left an object resembling an arched bridge against the background of a distant bluish-green landscape. On the right pink, green, black colours, more painterly surfaces at the top. The lower part of the painting mainly consists of clearly bounded, mostly sharp-angled geometric surfaces in whitish and muted tones.

6067.dm: kõrgus: 27.0 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 31.0 cm
6067.d: Kuuekandiline, 4 cm paksune, tumesinine-lillakas objekt, mille mõlemal poolel sinistes, rohelistes, oranžides ja punastes toonides geomeetrilistest pindadest maalingud. Ühel poolel moodustub kuusnurkne täht, teisel siniste pindadega piiratud kuusnurk, kahel pool rohelised kolmnurgad, keskel kirju, ruudu ja kahe rombiga kujund.
6067.de: A hexagonal, 4 cm thick, dark blue-purplish object, with paintings of geometric surfaces in blue, green, orange and red tones on both sides. On one side a six-pointed star is formed, on the other a hexagon bounded by blue surfaces, with green triangles on either side, and in the centre a colourful figure with a square and two rhombi.

6094.d: Erinevas suuruses geomeetrilistest kujunditest mosaiigitaoliselt kombineeritud kompositsioon, mille keskpunktis otseti  lamav naisakt, põlved enda alla konksu tõmmatud. Naise vasak käsi on pisut tõstetult välja sirutatud, parema (küünarnukist kõverdatud käe) labakäsi toetab lühikeste sirgete juustega pead. Figuuri reiepiirkonnas kolm risti. Väljasirutatud käest vasakul kuusirp. Figuuri kohal foonil on teisigi maastikule viitavad detaile (täht, majakatus). Valdavalt tumeroosades, beežides, sinistes toonides.
6094.de: A composition combined mosaic-like from geometric shapes of varying size, at the centre of which lies a female nude, viewed straight on, knees drawn up beneath her. The woman's left arm is stretched out, slightly raised; the hand of her right arm (bent at the elbow) supports her head, which has short straight hair. In the thigh area of the figure, three crosses. To the left of the outstretched arm, a crescent moon. Above the figure, in the background, are other details referring to a landscape (a star, a roof of a house). Predominantly in dark pink, beige, and blue tones.

6299.dm: kõrgus: 27.1 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 31.2 cm
6299.d: Kolmnurkne, 4 cm paksune plaat, kahel pool ja servadel, sinakas-hallil foonil sinistes-rohelistes-oranžides-punastes toonides geomeetrilised pinnad. Ühel küljel kolmnurk värvilistest, kolmnurksetest pindadest, väljaspool kolm, punaste äärtega ovaali, kaks seest sinised, kolmas punane. Teisel küljel sinistest pindadest ruut, mille peal osaliselt roheline ruut. Viimase sees punase äärega ovaal. All, osaliselt sinisel pinnal, vasakul ja paremal punase äärega ovaal. Piki külgi pikaks venitatud kolmnurgad, põhjal sini-punane ruut ja kaks ovaali - roheline-sinine ja punane-roheline.
6299.de: A triangular plate, 4 cm thick, on both sides and edges, on a bluish-grey background geometric surfaces in blue-green-orange-red tones. On one side a triangle of coloured, triangular surfaces, outside three oval shapes with red edges, two blue inside, the third red. On the other side a square of blue surfaces, on top of which a partially green square. Inside the latter an oval with a red edge. Below, partly on a blue surface, on the left and right an oval with a red edge. Along the sides, elongated triangles, at the bottom a blue-red square and two ovals - green-blue and red-green.

6300.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm; sügavus: 4.0 cm; laius: 27.2 cm
6300.d: Kaheksanurkne, 4 cm paksune plaat, kahelt poolt maalitud sinistes-punastes-rohelistes toonides, geomeetriliste pindadega. Ühel küljel kaheksanurkne meandri motiiv, selgepiiriliselt eraldatud, värvilistest ribadest. Teisel küljel kaheksanurkne täht, mis moodustub sinakas-hallil foonil värvilistest kolmnurkadest. Küljed ühevärvilised, sinakas-hallid.
6300.de: An octagonal, 4 cm thick plate, painted on both sides in blue, red and green tones, with geometric surfaces. On one side an octagonal meander motif, clearly delineated, of coloured stripes. On the other side an octagonal star, formed of coloured triangles against a bluish-grey background. The sides are monochrome, bluish-grey.

6353.d: Harkisjalu seisev deformeeritud, eriti pea ja jalad, alasti naisfiguur otsevaates dekoratiivsete puude vahel oleva helesiniste pilvedega kaetud virsikutooni ekraani ees. Aktil üks käsi puusal, teine kuklas, jalgealusel erkkollane ruut, millel paremal kõverate jalgadega taburet, sangaga pott üksiku punase õiega platel. Figuuri ja esemete selged varjud langemas alusele. Kujutatu ühtlasel erkoranžil taustal. Ühtlane peen oranž kontuurjoon ümbritseb plastiliselt vormitud figuuri ja kujundeid.
6353.de: A standing, straddle-legged, deformed – especially the head and legs – nude female figure in frontal view among decorative trees, in front of a peach-toned screen covered with light blue clouds. The nude has one hand on her hip, the other at the back of her neck, on the base beneath her feet a bright yellow square, on which stands, to the right, a stool with curved legs, a pot with a handle on a plate with a single red flower. Clear shadows of the figure and objects fall onto the base. The subject is set against a uniform bright orange background. An even, thin orange contour line surrounds the plastically shaped figure and forms.

6379.dm: kõrgus: 212.0 cm; sügavus: 10.0 cm; laius: 120.0 cm
6379.d: Valdavalt valgega kaetud reljeefne pind. Alusele puistatud puru, hiljem kaetud valgega. Paremal küljel alusele kleebitud pisut kortsutatud ja osliselt ca 5 cm eenduvad paberid, kohati kaetud värviga. Vasakus alumises neljandikus metallseier, mille elektriline ajam tagaküljel. Pildil vasakul ülal voolavad mustad värvinired.
6379.de: A relief surface covered predominantly in white. Debris scattered onto the support, later covered with white. On the right side, slightly crumpled papers glued onto the support, projecting about 5 cm in places, partly covered with paint. In the lower left quarter, a metal pointer with an electric motor on the back. At the upper left of the picture, black streams of paint flow.

6380.dm: kõrgus: 212.0 cm; sügavus: 10.0 cm; laius: 120.0 cm
6380.d: Vaarikapunase üldtooniga, reljeefse puruga kaetud maal. Pinnale kinnitatud kaks püstjat kilepaberist ja kolm põiki triipu, mis omakorda hõõguvpunase tooniga kaetud. Vasakus alumises neljandikus pinnale kinnitatud neli traadist põikitriipu ja vaskne kellamehhanism, millest lähtub oranžikas seieri kujund.
6380.de: A painting in an overall raspberry-red tone, covered with relief crumb. Two vertical strips of film paper and three horizontal strips are attached to the surface, which in turn are covered in a glowing red tone. In the lower left quarter, four horizontal wire strips and a copper clock mechanism are attached to the surface, from which an orange-toned hand shape emerges.

6381.d: Vineeritahvlile kinnitatud neli ca 24 cm laiust horisontaalset vineeririba, milledel ümarad geeliplekid. Kahel keskmisel ribal kuus ja äärmistel seitse plekki. Alusvineeril keskel, ülalt alla mustad kandilised templijäljendid.
6381.de: Four horizontal plywood strips, each ca 24 cm wide, attached to a plywood panel, with round gel stains on them. On the two middle strips six stains, and on the outer ones seven stains. In the centre of the base plywood, from top to bottom, black square stamp imprints.

6382.d: Vineerplaadi servad ääristatud ca 5 cm laiuse ebatasase geeliribaga.
6382.de: The edges of the plywood board are lined with an uneven gel strip about 5 cm wide.

6486.dm: kõrgus: 170.0 cm; sügavus: 3.0 cm; laius: 170.0 cm
6486.d: Pronksvärviga toonitud aluse keskel ovaalse kujuga helesinistest plastikroosiõitest kogum. Teose äärtel volditud sinised plastikaadiribad.
6486.de: In the centre of a base tinted bronze colour, an oval-shaped cluster of light blue plastic rose blossoms. Folded blue plastic strips at the edges of the work.

6543.d: Tumehallil lõuendil keskel paksu kihina horisontaalne ebakorrapärase kujuga must laik. Värvi on justkui kortsutades ära kraabitud. Kogu maali pind jätab kratsitud, kriimustatud, torgitud mulje. Ülal ja alaosas mitmed sisselõiked - rebendid. Suurim neist all vasakul: ca 2x20 cm. Maali ülaosas lõuend tumedamat tooni kui all. Minimalistlik, monokroomne.
6543.de: On a dark grey canvas, in the centre, a thick layer forming an irregularly shaped horizontal black stain. The paint appears to have been scraped off as if crumpled. The entire surface of the painting gives an impression of being scratched, scraped, and pricked. Above and below there are several incisions – tears. The largest of them, at lower left: approx. 2x20 cm. In the upper part of the painting the canvas is darker in tone than below. Minimalist, monochrome.

6606.d: Punakais, pruunikais, sinistes toonides värviliseks maalitud tahveluks. Värvid pole kompaktsed, pigem hägusalt markeeritud. Paremal serval keskel pruuniga märgistatud aimatav lingi koht.
6606.de: A panel painted in reddish, brownish, blue tones. The colours are not compact, rather hazily indicated. On the right edge, in the centre, marked with brown, the discernible place of a hinge.

6608.d: Viilkatusega maja läbilõike sürrealistlik kujutis. Pildil ees keskel abielupaari poolfiguurid vaataja suunas, külgedel seinakõrgused lapsenäod piiravad ruumi. Majas sümmeetriliselt neli väikeste ruutudega akent kirka maastikuvaatega. Ees vasakul ümar laud praega, tagapool paremal olevustest ümbritsetud trumm-klaver. Tumeda lae keskel viilu tipus kujutatud pärani suu, hambad paljad, aplikatsiooni kujul lihaseline käsi-tiib paremal, skeletiosa vasakul. Kahel pool lae ja seina piiril liigutatavad mõõka hoidva käe kujutised. Pildil veel hulk joonistatud/maalitud, ruumilisi detaile. Kompositsioon ümbritsetud puitlattidega, aluspaber kinnitatud kleeplindiga.
6608.de: A surrealist depiction of a cross-section of a gable-roofed house. In the picture, in the front centre, the half-figures of a married couple face the viewer, on the sides wall-height children's faces bound the space. In the house, symmetrically, four small-paned windows with a bright landscape view. In front on the left a round table with a roast, further back on the right a drum piano surrounded by beings. In the centre of the dark ceiling, at the tip of the gable, a wide-open mouth is depicted, teeth bared, a muscular hand-wing in the form of an appliqué on the right, a skeletal part on the left. On both sides, at the border of the ceiling and wall, movable depictions of a hand holding a sword. The picture also contains a number of drawn/painted, three-dimensional details. The composition is bordered with wooden strips, the backing paper is fastened with adhesive tape.

6888.d: Põhjamaiselt sinistes toonides lopsakas järvevaade. Horisondil paremal saar. Taga vastaskaldal kuppelmaastik. Taamal suured rünkpilved, peamiselt vertikaalsed, moodustades nii omalaadse triibustiku. Pilved peegelduvad ees järves.
6888.de: A lush lake view in northerly blue tones. On the horizon to the right an island. Behind, on the opposite shore, a domed landscape. In the distance large cumulus clouds, mainly vertical, thus forming a peculiar striping. The clouds are reflected in the lake in front.

6962.d: Väga pastoosne, tumeroosade, roheliste ja kollaste pintslitõmmetega kujund. Markeerivalt aimatav portree-nägu, mis toetub vasakule käele. Värvikiht kohati ulatub ka raamile.
6962.de: A very pastose shape with dark pink, green and yellow brushstrokes. A portrait face is markingly discernible, resting on the left hand. The paint layer at places extends onto the frame as well.

6987.d: Erksavärviline dekoratiivne kompositsioon mitmesugustest kujunditest, figuuridest. Maali alumisel poolel: valdavalt ultramariinsinisel roheliste, kollaste, punaste täpikeste, oonekeste, tähtede krähmuga kaetud pinnal pealtvaade sinisele härjataolisele olevusele, jäsemed laiali. Tema kohal lendkala peapoole kujutis kaetud roheliste tähtede, sõnajuppidega. Ülaosas paremal kollase joonega markeeritud kaks istuvat inimfiguuri. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus oranž-kollane tiivuline kujund mehepeaga külgvaates.
6987.de: Brightly coloured decorative composition of various figures and shapes. On the lower half of the painting: a predominantly ultramarine-blue surface covered with a scattering of green, yellow and red dots, ovals, stars, showing a top view of a blue bull-like creature with limbs spread apart. Above it, a depiction of a flying fish, head-first, covered with green stars and fragments of writing. In the upper right, two seated human figures marked with a yellow line. In the upper left quarter, an orange-yellow winged shape with a man's head, in profile.

7097.d: Valkjas-hall lõuend horisontaalsete läbilõigete ning augukestega üle kogu maali pinna. Mustjas-hallid vaba käejoonega tõmmatud triibud maalil on samuti horisontaalsed. Taotluslikud rebendid asetsevad suurema kogumina maali paremal poolel ning alaosas. Vasakul ning ülal esineb neid vähem ning mõõtmetelt on need väiksemad.
7097.de: A whitish-grey canvas with horizontal cuts and small holes across the entire surface of the painting. The blackish-grey freehand-drawn stripes on the painting are likewise horizontal. Deliberate tears are concentrated in a larger group on the right side and lower part of the painting. There are fewer of them, and they are smaller in size, on the left and upper part.

7241.d: Värvikas kompositsioon naiivses-karikeerivas laadis stiliseeritud naisekeha vormidest, geomeetrilistest dekoratiivsetest kujunditest paigutatuna pildipinnale kaarjalt vasakult poolelt paremale alla. Allosas külili triibuliste reitega nukulik torso. Paremal all väiksem maskiga, naiserinnaga kuju. Vasakul ülal silmaava kujund ja rinnad koonusena suunaga paremale. Üksikud kujundid-vormid ülal paremal hõljumas lillakaspruunis avaruses. Selgepiiriliselt eraldatud, enamasti ruumiliselt kujutatud vormid.
7241.de: A colourful composition in a naive-caricature style of stylised female body forms and geometric decorative shapes arranged across the picture plane in an arc from the upper left to the lower right. Below, a doll-like torso lying on its side with striped thighs. Lower right, a smaller figure with a mask and female breasts. Upper left, an eye-opening shape and breasts as cones pointing to the right. Individual shapes-forms floating in the upper right in a lilac-brown expanse. Sharply delineated forms, mostly depicted with volume.

7242.d: Suvine vaade piki mereäärt kõrge rünkpilvise taevaga. Vasakul kivine rand, valge lainesäbru veepiiril, silmapiiril meri. Paremal kõrge liivane kallas, üleval roheline murukamar.
7242.de: Summer view along the seashore with a high cumulus sky. On the left, a stony beach, white wave foam at the water's edge, sea on the horizon. On the right, a high sandy bank, green turf above.

7249.d: Värvikas kompositsioon dekoratiivsetest kujunditest põimituna nukulike naisekeha vormidega. Allosas keskel stiliseeritud torso otsevaates. Pildi keskel ruudukujulist pinda piiravad dekoratiivsed sektorid jm. Selgepiiriliselt eraldatud kujundid enamasti ruumiliselt kujutatud, valdavalt punased, pruunid ja türkiisi toonid.
7249.de: A colourful composition interwoven with decorative figures and doll-like female body forms. At the bottom centre, a stylised torso seen frontally. In the middle of the picture, a square-shaped surface bordered by decorative sectors and the like. The clearly delineated figures are mostly rendered with volume, predominantly in red, brown and turquoise tones.

7352.d: Roosal taustal valged laigud. Musta-halliga üle pildi pinna mitmesugused joonkujundid, mis moodustavad abstraktse näo joonise. Ülal keskel kaks sõõrjat silma, keskel markeeritud nina ning all avatud ümar suu. Paiguti markeerivalt maalitud ka näo piirjooni.
7352.de: White patches on a pink background. Black-and-grey various linear forms across the surface of the picture, forming an abstract drawing of a face. Above in the middle two round eyes, a marked nose in the centre, and below an open round mouth. In places the contours of the face are also marked in paint.

7353.d: Abstraktne, veidi pastoosne, voolavate värvijugade ning -pritsmetega maali keskosas paikneb suur tumelillas-violetses toonis sõõr, mida läbib diagonaal. Taust heledam, kollastest toonides. Mitmel pool punaseid, siniseid, valgeid värvilaike.
7353.de: An abstract, slightly pastose painting with flowing streams and splashes of paint; in the middle of the picture a large circle in dark purple-violet tones, crossed by a diagonal. Background lighter, in yellowish tones. In several places patches of red, blue, white paint.

7354.d: Abstraktne, mitut tooni kollased ümaravormilised kujundid. Vasakul keskel vertikaalselt suur must ebakorrapärane laik. Paremal all sarnane motiiv valkjas-kollakas toonis. Maali üla- ja alaosal tumeda värviga kohati pastoossed "kammi" jäljendid. Keskel horisontaalne ebasümmeetriline kollastes toonides kujund. Maalil hõljuv-voolav meeleolu, mikroorganisme meenutav.
7354.de: Abstract, yellow rounded shapes in several tones. In the middle left a large irregular black blotch, vertical. Lower right a similar motif in whitish-yellow tone. In the upper and lower parts of the painting, dark-coloured, occasionally impasto "comb" traces. In the centre a horizontal asymmetrical shape in yellow tones. The painting has a hovering, flowing mood, reminiscent of microorganisms.

7416.d: Kaks vaevu markeeritud nägudega naisefiguuri kummaski pildi servas. Mõlemal seljas kraedega rohelisekirjud kleidid ja peas tanu või turbanit meenutavad peakatted. Naiste vahel hele, pealt punane, torti meenutav kujund. Foon koosneb tihedalt üksteise kõrvale tipitud rohelistest, punasega ümbritsetud rõngastest.
7416.de: Two female figures with barely marked faces on each edge of the picture. Both wear green-patterned dresses with collars and headwear resembling a bonnet or a turban. Between the women a light form, red on top, resembling a torte. The background consists of green rings tightly stitched next to one another, surrounded by red.

7570.d: Üksikutest, tihedalt läbimaalitud värvilaikudest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon: ülaserv roheline, parem serv must, allservas keskel valge ja kollane kujund, vasakul kolmnurk, mida rohelisest ülaosast eraldab must joon.
7570.de: Abstract composition consisting of individual, densely painted-through patches of colour: the upper edge green, the right edge black, in the lower edge centre a white and yellow shape, on the left a triangle, separated from the green upper part by a black line.

7571.d: Kontseptualistlik maal, kus monokroomsele reproduktsioonile on peale maalitud hallid geomeetrilised pinnad. Vasakul ülal ja paremal heledam hall, all pruunikam. Keskosas püstine tumedam ristkülik, millel must ja valge U-laadne kujund moodustab veelkord ristkülikulaadse elemendi. Allääres trükikiri: Rembrandt Harmensz van Rijn. 1606-1669. Young woman with earrings 1657. Paremas nurgas: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD
7571.de: A conceptualist painting in which grey geometric surfaces have been painted over a monochrome reproduction. Upper left and right a lighter grey, below a brownish tone. In the centre a vertical darker rectangle, on which a black and white U-shaped form once more forms a rectangular element. At the bottom printed text: Rembrandt Harmensz van Rijn. 1606-1669. Young woman with earrings 1657. In the right corner: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD

7572.d: Reporduktsioonile maalitud must-valge geomeetriline sõrestikulaadne kujund. Taust hall. Maali ülaosas, sõrestiku kohal must ebakorrapärane poolring. Maali alaosas, keskel must nelinurk, mille peal veidi väiksem valge ristkülik. Allääres trükikirjas: ANTHONY VAN DYCK 1566-1641. SELF-PORTRAIT. late 1620s-early 1630s. Paremal allääres: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD.
7572.de: A black-and-white geometric lattice-like form painted onto a reproduction. The background is grey. In the upper part of the painting, above the lattice, an irregular black semicircle. In the lower part of the painting, in the centre, a black quadrangle, on top of which a slightly smaller white rectangle. Along the lower edge, in printed text: ANTHONY VAN DYCK 1566-1641. SELF-PORTRAIT. late 1620s-early 1630s. Lower right: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD.

7573.d: Reproduktsioonile maalitud mustal taustal valged ebamäärase kujuga, pilvi meenutavad pinnad. Taustast kohati pruune toone läbi kumamas. Allääres trükikirjas: CASPAR DAVID FRIEDRICH. 1774-1840. ON A SAILING SHIP. paremal THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD
7573.de: Painted onto the reproduction, on a black background, white surfaces of indeterminate shape resembling clouds. In places brown tones show through the background. Along the lower edge in printed lettering: CASPAR DAVID FRIEDRICH. 1774-1840. ON A SAILING SHIP. on the right THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD

7574.d: Reproduktsioonile maalitud musta, halli ja valgega abstraktses laadis nelinurkne kujund. Taust pruunikas-hall. Nelinurga alaosas domineerib must, ülaosas valge. Alaääres trükikirjas: ARTIST OF THE PIETER BRUEGHEL THE ELDER CIRCLE. Early 17th century. WINTER LANDSCAPE
7574.de: A rectangular abstract-style shape painted in black, grey and white on a reproduction. Background brownish-grey. Black dominates the lower part of the rectangle, white the upper part. In print at the lower edge: ARTIST OF THE PIETER BRUEGHEL THE ELDER CIRCLE. Early 17th century. WINTER LANDSCAPE

7656.d: Kümnest sõõri kujundist moodustatud, näpitskruvidega omavahel ühendatud,
7656.de: Formed of ten circular shapes, connected to each other with thumbscrews,

7801.d: Diagonaalselt üle pildi kaugusse suunduv sõudepaaditaoline konveier, hallid figuurid paarikaupa aerude asemel pintsleid hoidmas ja vikerkaarevärvi maalitahvleid võõpamas. Ees paremal kaks rohelist koonilistes kübarates, sõudjate-maalijate vahel üks piitsaga järelvaataja. Metafüüsiline must ruum sõrestikaknaga laes.
7801.de: A conveyor resembling a rowboat running diagonally across the picture into the distance, grey figures in pairs holding brushes instead of oars and painting rainbow-coloured painting panels. In front on the right two figures in green conical hats, among the rowers-painters an overseer with a whip. A metaphysical black space with a lattice window in the ceiling.

7980.d: Abstraktses laadis värvirõõmus maal. Vasaku serva ülaosa kollane, alaosa sinine. Üldpinnal domineerivad sinakas-hallid ja heledada toonid. Maali keskpinnal mitmetes erksates toonides värvijooni. Parem serv rahuliku, helehalli pastelse koloriidiga.
7980.de: An abstract painting joyful in colour. The upper part of the left edge yellow, the lower part blue. Bluish-grey and light tones dominate the overall surface. In the centre of the painting colour lines in various bright tones. The right edge has a calm, light grey pastel colouring.

7988.d: Vasak: istuv alasti vanamees, jalad laiali, parem käsi kõrval, vasak põlvel, vaatab enda ette; vasak jalg välja maalimata. Kujutisel tugev kontuur, pruunid ja lillad toonid; taust hall.
7988.de: Left: a seated naked old man, legs apart, right hand at his side, left hand on his knee, looking straight ahead; the left leg unpainted. The image has a strong contour, brown and purple tones; the background gray.

7989.d: Rohekas-hallil roosade laikudega foonil tugevate tumedate piirjoontega abstraktne kujund. Kujundist väljuvad rohekad torujad moodustised, keskosal on punased ja roosad pinnad. Maali ülaservas vasakul markeerivale maalitud veel üks torujas detail, põhitoonilt rohekas-must, punase aktsendiga ülaosas.(eesti)
7989.de: Against a greenish-grey background with pink patches, an abstract shape with strong dark contour lines. Greenish tubular formations emerge from the shape, the central part having red and pink surfaces. In the upper left edge of the painting, painted in a marking manner, one more tubular detail, mainly greenish-black in tone, with a red accent at the top.

8133.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas valge sügava dekolteega kleit. Üle õlgade heidetud roosa rätik.
8133.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a white dress with a deep décolletage. A pink shawl thrown over the shoulders.

8311.d: Maalipind valdavalt tumesiniste, mustjas-roheliste voogavate lainekujunditega, vahel hõõguvpunased leegid, sädemed. Paremal all leekiva peaga leekivpunane poolakt, kõverdatud käed, parem jalg tõstetud, pimedusest esile kerkimas. Figuur niuete kohal käe embuses, temast paremal all avatud suuga suur hirmunud nägu. Ekspressiivne laad, läikiv maalipind, pahtlimaali faktuur, värviga vormiv.(eesti)
8311.de: The painted surface predominantly with dark blue, blackish-green flowing wave shapes, at times glowing red flames, sparks. Below right a flaming red half-nude with a blazing head, bent arms, right leg raised, emerging from the darkness. The figure embraced by an arm at the hips, to its right below an open-mouthed large frightened face. Expressive manner, glossy painted surface, impasto texture, form-giving through colour.

8467.d: Punastes, mustades, valgetes toonides maali domineeriv värv on kollane. Abstraktses laadis. Kollaseid horisontaalseid lainjaid jooni on paigutatud üle kogu pildipinna. Kujunduselementidena mõjuvad ka siin-seal vedela värvi valgumisest tekkind joad, mis on ka veidi reljeefsed.
8467.de: In red, black and white tones, the dominant colour of the painting is yellow. In an abstract style. Yellow horizontal wavy lines are placed all over the picture surface. Streams formed by the dripping of liquid paint, which are also slightly relief-like, also function as design elements here and there.

8533.d: Kaks söega tumedaks töödeldud vineertahvlit, pind kulunud, selles väikesed ümmargused augud ja naelad.
8533.de: Two plywood panels charred with coal, the surface worn, with small round holes and nails in it.

8601.dm: laius: 153.0 cm (II osa (reljeefi kõrgus 12 cm)); kõrgus: 153.0 cm; kõrgus: 153.0 cm; laius: 153.0 cm (I osa (reljeefi kõrgus 12 cm))
8601.d: Kaheosaline ruumiline kompositsioon vineeralusel, millele kinnitatud hulk erinevast materjalist olmejääke, esemeid: plastikvormid, õllepurgid, plastikrosett, riideribad, puitdetailid, ažuursed metalliribad jm. Esemete kuhi kulgeb alt vasakult üles paremale. Paremal äärel plastikrõngaste rida. Vineeralus veidi toonitud.
8601.de: A two-part spatial composition on a plywood base, to which a number of household waste items and objects of various materials are attached: plastic moulds, beer cans, a plastic rosette, strips of cloth, wooden details, openwork metal strips etc. The heap of objects runs from the bottom left up to the right. On the right edge a row of plastic rings. The plywood base is slightly tinted.

8624.d: Alumine pool kujutisest sügavsinine meri valgete laineharjadega. Ülemine pool peaaegu valge taevas, sinakate, paremal valgest läbikumavate, punakate kaldpintslitõmmetega - meenutab jäämäge, mille tipp kujutise ülemise servaga ära lõigatud.
8624.de: The lower half of the image is deep blue sea with white wave crests. The upper half is an almost white sky, with bluish, reddish diagonal brushstrokes shining through white on the right - reminiscent of an iceberg, whose peak is cut off by the upper edge of the image.

8626.d: Maali pind jagatud kuueks erivärviliseks püstiasendis ristkülikuks. Ülareas rohekas - kollane, punane, tumesinine, all ooker, lilla, roheline. Värvilistel pindadel väikesed lõigatud laigukesed, mis toovad nähtavale alumised värvikihid, moodustades samal ajal teat. rütmilise mustri. Ülemises reas kahel äärmisel värvipaneelil ning all keskmisel on lõikelaigukesed sümmeetriliselt ridades. Nende vastasolevatel ristkülikutel on augukesed koondunud tsentrumisse, moodustades nii väikese kobara.
8626.de: The surface of the painting is divided into six vertically oriented rectangles of different colours. In the upper row: greenish-yellow, red, dark blue; below: ochre, purple, green. On the coloured surfaces small cut-out spots reveal the lower layers of paint, at the same time forming a certain rhythmic pattern. On the two outermost colour panels in the upper row and on the middle one below, the cut spots are arranged symmetrically in rows. On the opposite rectangles the small holes are concentrated in the centre, forming a small cluster.

8716.d: Heleroheline pind krobestatud mitmesuguste materjalidega. Vasakul servas vertikaalne, veidi kaardus lillakas-roosakas-tumedam veidi kõrgem krobeline joon. Teine sarnane paremal all servas. Maali ülaosas ja ka all horisontaalsed, veidi eenduvad kõrgendikud-mügarikud. Rohelise värvi alt kumab siin-seal läbi punast.
8716.de: Light green surface roughened with various materials. On the left edge a vertical, slightly curved purplish-pinkish, darker, somewhat higher rough line. A similar one on the lower right edge. In the upper part of the painting and also below, horizontal, slightly protruding elevations-bumps. Red shows through here and there beneath the green paint.

8785.d: Värvilistest plekkpurkidest kompositsioon. Ülaosas helesinine-valge pilvelaadne kujund. Alaosa must, mõningate värviliste aksentidega. All paremal elektronkella oranž number 13:46.
8785.de: A composition of coloured tin cans. In the upper part a light blue-white cloud-like form. The lower part black, with some coloured accents. Lower right the orange number 13:46 of an electronic clock.

9009.d: Loomanaha kujuga atsetaatkilest alus, mille ülemistes nurkades metallrõngad kinnituseks. Kile toonitud aerosoolvärvidega pronksikarva.
9009.de: A base made of acetate film in the shape of an animal skin, with metal rings in the upper corners for fastening. The film tinted bronze-coloured with aerosol paints.

9053.d: Värviline, peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuv kompositsioon, millest aimuvad ülalt vasakult diagonaalis alla liikuvad figuurid. Esiplaanil all mikrofoni koos statiiviga käes hoidev laulja. Ekspressiivne maalimislaad.
9053.de: A colourful, almost abstract-seeming composition, in which figures moving diagonally from upper left to lower right can be discerned. In the foreground below, a singer holding a microphone with a stand. Expressive painting style.

9163.d: Valgeks maalitud puidust kapiuks, mille ülakolmandikus on veidi diagonaalne valge horisontaaljoon, mis ei ulatu kummastki otsast servani. Keskel, horisontaaljoone taga on ülalt alla, alt veidi vasakule diagonaalne laiem (u. 19 cm) valge joon, mille otsad samuti ei ulatu maali servadeni.
9163.de: A cupboard door of wood painted white, in whose upper third there is a slightly diagonal white horizontal line that does not reach either edge. In the centre, behind the horizontal line, a wider (approx. 19 cm) white line running diagonally from top to bottom, slightly to the left at the bottom, whose ends likewise do not reach the edges of the painting.

9166.d: Valdavalt sinistes-punastes toonides, osalt peenes pintslikirjas, osalt ühtlastest värvipindadest fantaasiamaastikku meenutav abstraktne kompositsioon. Tumedate sinakate pindade vahel, justkui punaka valgusega kaetud, pildi sügavuses helendav sõrestikuline ulmelinn.
9166.de: An abstract composition, predominantly in blue-red tones, partly in fine brushwork, partly of even colour surfaces, resembling a fantasy landscape. Between dark bluish surfaces, as if covered by a reddish light, a glowing lattice-like futuristic city in the depth of the picture.

9226.dm: laius: 123.0 cm (osa II (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm)); kõrgus: 210.0 cm; kõrgus: 210.0 cm; laius: 123.0 cm (osa I (reljeefi kõrgus 5 cm))
9226.d: Kaheosaline ruumiline kompositsioon. Osaliselt kortsutatud ja rebitud kirevalt ülemaalitud paberiga kaetud alusele kinnitatud valdavalt pronksivärvi plastikplaadi tükke, metalliosi, sinise köie jupp jms. detaile esemetest. Kinnitatud materjal on alusele paigutatud astmeliselt: vasakul äärel all, horisontaalselt pinna keskel ja ülal paremal äärel.
9226.de: A two-part spatial composition. Pieces of predominantly bronze-coloured plastic sheet, metal parts, a piece of blue rope and similar object details are attached to a base covered with partially crumpled and torn, colourfully overpainted paper. The attached material is arranged on the base in steps: at the bottom on the left edge, horizontally in the middle of the surface, and at the top on the right edge.

9527.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon: tumepruunil foonil peaaegu kogu pildi pinda täitev tumesinine ristkülik, mis kaetud heledamate siniste läbisegi-joontega nii, et korrapäraste vahedega jooksevad üle pildi pinna horisontaalsed sinised triibud.
9527.de: Abstract composition: on a dark brown background a dark blue rectangle filling almost the entire picture surface, covered with lighter blue intermingled lines so that, at regular intervals, horizontal blue stripes run across the picture surface.

9529.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud rangelt tasakaalustatud abstraktne kompositsioon. Allservas ja -nurkades domineerib erkroheline ja kollane, keskel valge ja must, ülanurkades roosa.
9529.de: A strictly balanced abstract composition made up of coloured geometric shapes. Bright green and yellow dominate at the bottom edge and corners, white and black in the middle, pink in the upper corners.

9683.d: Punasele pinnale on veidi kaootiliselt paigutatud mitmesugused kujundid. Maali keskosas ülakolmandikus on lillaka varjundiga veidi reljeefne nelinurk, mida diagonaalselt poolitab reljeefne joon. Nelinurk on ühendatud vasakul asuva trepilaadse kujundiga. All, vasakus servas on ebakorrapärane roosa-lilla ja punaste värvinüanssidega mitmest ristkülikust koosnev nelinurk. Maali keskosast veidi paremale jäävad kaks kujundit. Allpool punane kolmnurk, millel punakasvalge ruut. Sellest paremale jääb kõrge trapetsilaadne sinakas-punakas kujund, millest kasvab välja reljeefne silmustega kaarjoon, mis tipneb hõõguvpunase maalitud ristkülikuga. All paremas servas sinine rant.
9683.de: Various shapes are arranged somewhat chaotically on a red surface. In the upper third of the middle part of the painting there is a slightly relief quadrangle with a purplish tint, diagonally bisected by a relief line. The quadrangle is connected to a stair-like shape located on the left. At the bottom, in the left margin, there is an irregular quadrangle composed of several rectangles in pink-purple and red colour nuances. Slightly to the right of the middle of the painting there are two shapes. Below is a red triangle with a reddish-white square on it. To the right of it is a tall, trapezoid-like bluish-red shape, from which grows a relief looped arched line culminating in a glowing red painted rectangle. In the lower right margin there is a blue edge.

9725.d: Kahe-osaline kompositsioon värvitud plekkpurkidest puitraamistuses. Ülemisel, helesinisel taustal üks terve ja pool kuuekandilise numbrilauaga kella, must kontuur, värvilised osutid. Alumisel osal oranžil taustal valgega kiri SEIS peegeldusega, selle all elektronkella näit 2106. Allääres kollasel taustal number 2016.
9725.de: Two-part composition in painted tin cans within a wooden frame. On the upper, light blue background one whole and half of a clock with a hexagonal dial, black contour, coloured hands. On the lower part, on an orange background, the word SEIS [STOP] in white with a reflection, below it the reading of an electronic clock 2106. At the bottom edge, on a yellow background, the number 2016.

9755.d: Orgaanilise vormiga poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille pikitelge läbib aimatav inimfiguur, mis pildi vasakus osas ühineb aimatava loomapäise figuuriga. Viimistletud täppivas laadis, läbivad toonid hall, must ja murtud punased.
9755.de: Semi-abstract composition with organic form, its longitudinal axis pierced by a discernible human figure, which in the left part of the picture unites with a discernible animal-headed figure. Executed in a refined, pointillist manner, dominant tones grey, black and broken red.

9758.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon  tumedatest, hoogsalt maalitud spiraalsetest kujunditest diagonaalselt üle heleda roosakasbeezi tausta.
9758.de: Abstract composition of dark, vigorously painted spiral shapes diagonally across a light pinkish-beige background.

9791.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon lõuendile kleebitud ja üle maalitud rebitud ajaleheväljalõigete ja kahe tumehalli, selgelt piiritletud ringiga.
9791.de: Abstract composition made of torn newspaper clippings glued onto canvas and painted over, with two clearly delineated dark grey circles.

9829.d: Kollasteks ja sinisteks ruutjateks pindadeks jaotatud abstraktne kompositsioon punase keraga keskmes. Kerajast vormist hargneb kuni pildi allosani voolavat juga meenutav lintjas vorm. Laad vaba ja maaliline.
9829.de: An abstract composition divided into yellow and blue square-like areas with a red sphere at the centre. From the spherical form branches a ribbon-like form resembling a flowing stream, extending down to the bottom of the picture. Free and painterly manner.

The painting is bordered on the sides by a regular row of nails covered with paint.

9895.d: Mustade kulissidega piiratud hallitriibulisel näilisel laval kaks sürreaalset figuuri vastastikku. Vasakpoolne raudrüüd meenutavas varustuses, paremal värvilistest lappidest kombineeritud kuju.
9895.de: On an ostensible stage bounded by black wings with grey stripes, two surreal figures face each other. The figure on the left in gear reminiscent of armour, on the right a figure composed of coloured patches.

9896.d: Tumesinisel taustal näiliselt lendlevatest selgepiirilistest, justkui volditud abstraktsetest kujunditest kuhi.
9896.de: On a dark blue background a pile of seemingly floating, sharply outlined, as if folded abstract shapes.

9897.dm: kõrgus: 46.3 cm; sügavus: 3.5 cm; laius: 38.5 cm
9897.d: Mustal taustal sidemesse mässitud peaga sürreaalne poolfiguur, üle õla visatud erkpunase usskraega roheline mustriline rõivas.
9897.de: Against a black background, a surreal half-figure with its head wrapped in bandages, wearing a green patterned garment with a bright red ruff collar thrown over the shoulder.

9898.d: Sinkjal krähmulisel taustal erksavärvilistest kolmnurkadest, ringidest, rombidest koosnevat stiliseeritud figuuri üksteise kõrval rivis.
9898.de: On a bluish, crumpled background a stylised figure composed of brightly coloured triangles, circles and rhombi, standing in a row side by side.

9923.d: Raagus puuga lumise talvemaastiku taustal ja sellest välja kasvava heledapäise pikkade juustega noore naise 7/8 figuur otsevaates, pilk paremal. Naise keha katab kolme kase, puude ja majakestega lumise aia kujutis. Portree osa pilvetupsudega helesinise taeva taustal realistlikult, värvikalt maalitud.
9923.de: Against the background of a snowy winter landscape with a bare tree, and growing out of it, a 7/8 figure of a young fair-haired woman with long hair, seen frontally, gaze to the right. The woman's body is covered by the image of a snowy garden with three birches, trees and small houses. The portrait part is painted realistically and colourfully against the background of a light blue sky with tufts of cloud.

10015.d: Kompositsioon seisvate, urbanistlikule subkultuurile viitavates soengutes ja rõivastuses noorte inimestega. Esiplaanil olev inimgrupp vaataja poole seljaga, tagaplaanil olev inimgrupp vaataja poole näoga. Taust tumedates toonides abstraktne.
10015.de: A composition with standing young people with hairstyles and clothing referring to urban subculture. The group of people in the foreground has their backs to the viewer, the group in the background faces the viewer. The background is abstract in dark tones.

10016.d: Kompositsioon seisvate, urbanistlikule subkultuurile viitavates soengutes ja rõivastuses noorte inimestega. Kompositsiooni keskmes kaks vaataja poole pööratud figuuri, taust heledates toonides abstraktne.
10016.de: A composition with standing young people in hairstyles and clothing referring to urban subculture. At the centre of the composition two figures turned towards the viewer, the background abstract in light tones.

10017.d: Poolabstraktne, sinakas-hallikates toonides ateljeevaade, mille keskmes kaks skulpturaalset objekti ja üksteise najale asetatud pildiraamid.
10017.de: A semi-abstract studio view in bluish-grayish tones, at the centre of which are two sculptural objects and picture frames leaning against one another.

10018.d: Sinakates-hallikates toonides ateljeevaade skulpturaalsete objektide ja nende taustal olevate piltidega.
10018.de: Studio view in bluish-greyish tones with sculptural objects and pictures behind them.

10023.d: Valge abstraktne kompositsioon, mille ühest nurgast teise ulatuv voogav kujund maalitud tilgutades-reljeefselt.
10023.de: A white abstract composition, with a flowing shape extending from one corner to the other, painted in a dripped-relief manner.

10024.d: Tumedates toonides öine vaade aiaga ümbritsetud hoonetegrupile. Esiplaanil vasakul ristikujuline post, taamal hoonetegrupi taga väike majake.
10024.de: Night view in dark tones of a group of buildings surrounded by a fence. In the foreground on the left a cross-shaped post, behind the group of buildings a small house.

10027.d: Kollakates toonides linnavaade erinevate majade fassaadide ja katustega.
10027.de: Townscape in yellowish tones with facades and roofs of various houses.

10030.d: Stiliseeritud mägimaastiku vaade, mille mägine osa maalitud skemaatiliselt-mustvalgelt, taustal olev taevas kaetud ühtlaselt kollaselt.
10030.de: View of a stylised mountain landscape, whose mountainous part is painted schematically in black and white, the sky in the background covered evenly in yellow.

10031.d: Stiliseeritud mägimaastiku vaade, mille mägine osa maalitud skemaatiliselt-mustvalgelt, taustal olev taevas kaetud ühtlaselt kollaselt.
10031.de: View of a stylised mountain landscape, whose mountainous part is painted schematically in black and white, the sky in the background covered evenly in yellow.

10037.d: Punakates toonides maastikuvaade taluhoonetega, taustal silmapiir ja rohekas taevas.
10037.de: Landscape view in reddish tones with farm buildings, in the background the horizon and a greenish sky.

10094.d: Roosal foonil eri mõõdus ja toonides dekoratiivsed fallosed.
10094.de: Decorative phalluses of various sizes and tones on a pink background.

10095.d: Punakaspruunil foonil sinise kontuuriga markeeritud kolm figuuri (kaks poolprofiilis ja pead teineteise vastas asetsevat meesfiguuri, nende kõrval paremal keskel selili lamav sinisega maalitud naisfiguur). Taustal siin-seal lehestikku imiteeriv eri toonides dekoratiivne pind.
10095.de: Against a reddish-brown background, three figures marked with a blue outline (two male figures in half-profile with their heads facing each other, and beside them on the right in the middle, a reclining female figure painted in blue, lying on her back). In the background, here and there, a decorative surface in various tones imitating foliage.

10139.d: Teose keskel paikneb kaks pikkade pintslitõmmetega kujutatud abstraktset figuuri, mis sulanduvad kokku kollase-sinise-lilla triibulisse tausta.
10139.de: In the centre of the work are two abstract figures depicted with long brushstrokes, merging into a yellow-blue-purple striped background.

10226.d: Lillakaspunasel merel kolm valget kolmnurkset purje. Esiplaanil tumesinised kivimürakad, ülaservas kitsas riba oranži taevast.
10226.de: Three white triangular sails on a purplish-red sea. In the foreground dark blue rock masses, in the upper edge a narrow strip of orange sky.

10227.d: Keskel hallikas pikas rüüs mees, parem käsi välja sirutatud, pilk taevasse suunatud. Mehe vasakul õlal ja käsivarrel istuvad linnud, pea ümber värviline linnuparv. Vasakul all värviline põõsas, milles istub neli kirjut lindu.
10227.de: In the centre a man in a long greyish robe, right arm outstretched, gaze directed toward the sky. On the man's left shoulder and arm sit birds, around his head a colourful flock of birds. Lower left a colourful bush, in which four speckled birds sit.

10228.d: Allservas keskel stiliseeritud, laialisirutatud kätega inimfiguur poolringi meenutavat raskust hoidmas. Poolringikujundi allservas mustad kolmnurgad, nende kohal punastes ja sinistes toonides poolfiguuridest komponeeritud ornament.
10228.de: In the lower middle, a stylised human figure with outstretched arms holding up a weight resembling a semicircle. At the bottom of the semicircular shape, black triangles; above them, an ornament composed of half-figures in red and blue tones.

10229.d: Lillades, roosades, mustades toonides allservas soopinda meenutav abstraktne kompositsioon. Ülaosa roosakaspruun, ülaservas sinine triip.
10229.de: An abstract composition in violet, pink and black tones, the lower edge resembling a bog surface. The upper part pinkish-brown, with a blue stripe at the top edge.

10278.d: Helesinise ja valge gradatsiooniga taustal amorfne valge vorm.
10278.de: On a background with a light blue and white gradation an amorphous white form.

10280.d: Valgel taustal põlvitab pea maas beež amorfne figuur.
10280.de: On a white background a beige amorphous figure kneels with its head to the ground.

10282.d: Helesinisel taustal abstraktseid figuure meenutavad valged vormid. Kompositsiooni servi ümbritseb punane ääristus.
10282.de: On a light blue background, white forms resembling abstract figures. The edges of the composition are surrounded by a red border.

10283.d: Helesinise taustaga töö alumisel poolel hõljuvad üksteise kohal kaks istuvas poosis figuuri: alumine on suurem ja tumedam, ülemine väiksem ja heledam.
10283.de: In the lower half of the work, against a light blue background, two seated figures hover one above the other: the lower one is larger and darker, the upper one smaller and lighter.

10284.d: Kompositsioon laua ja sellele asetatud laekaga, mille ümber neli meest. Mehed maalitud popilikus võtmes, taust tumepruun.
10284.de: Composition with a table and a chest placed on it, surrounded by four men. The men are painted in a pop-art manner, background dark brown.

10285.d: Helesinisel taustal abstraktsed valged figuurid rõhutatud naiselike kehaosadega. Ühest otsast on figuurid deformeerunud pikaks ja kitsaks vormiks, kompositsiooni ülalservas hõljub kera.
10285.de: Against a light blue background, abstract white figures with emphasized feminine body parts. At one end the figures are deformed into a long and narrow form, at the top edge of the composition a sphere hovers.

10324.d: Keskel tumesinine, ülalt alla sööstvat lindu meenutav kujund, saba laiali, tiivanukid teravalt püsti. Linnu keha ja tiibade vahel kaks sügavat tumesinist silma. Foon linnu ümber ja allservas rohekas, ülal erksalt oranž. Linnu keha piirkonnas värvikihis kraapimisjäljed.
10324.de: In the center, a dark blue shape resembling a bird diving from above, tail spread, wing tips sharply upright. Between the bird's body and wings, two deep dark blue eyes. The background around the bird and at the lower edge is greenish, bright orange above. In the area of the bird's body, scratch marks in the paint layer.

10402.d: Keskel tumesinistes toonides lindu meenutav kujund, teravate tiivanukkidega. Tiivakaartes kaks suurt tumesinist silma. Linnufiguuri värvikihti on tõmmatud risti-rästi kriipsud maalipinna elavdamiseks. Foon pildi servades ja linnu ümber roheline, ülejäänud pildi pinnal oranž.
10402.de: In the centre a bird-like figure in dark blue tones, with sharp wing-tips. Two large dark blue eyes in the curve of the wings. Crisscrossing lines have been drawn over the paint layer of the bird figure to enliven the painted surface. The background at the edges of the picture and around the bird is green, the rest of the picture's surface orange.

10404.d: Tumesinise öise taeva foonil oranžilt tuledes kumavad pilvelõhkujate siluetid ja ähmaselt aimatav öine tänav esiplaanil.
10404.de: Against the background of a dark blue night sky, the silhouettes of skyscrapers glow orange with lights, and a dimly discernible night street in the foreground.

10405.d: Maalil kahel pool kulissidetaolised tumedad geomeetrilised pinnad, nende vahel helendub kollakas ruum. Valdavalt kollased, oranžid, sinised toonid, kontuure hajutav maaliline kujutamisviis.
10405.de: In the painting, on both sides dark geometrical planes resembling coulisses, between them a yellowish space glows. Predominantly yellow, orange, blue tones, a painterly manner of depiction that diffuses contours.

10439.d: Kollasel taustal visandlikult maalitud kolm istuvas asendis naisakti. Vasakpoolne ja keskmine istumas parema küljega vaataja poole. Vasakpoolse naise pea on pöördes parema õla suunas, pilk vaatab alla. Naise pea ja käed toetuvad vasakule kõverdatud põlvele, parem jalg madalamal. Keskmine figuur kõige visandlikumalt maalitud. Kuju mõlemad jalad on tõmmatud lõua alla konksu. Parempoolne naine on pigem püstises asendis, vaatega pildi keskplaani suunas. Värvigammalt on maal kollane, tooni annavad mustad kontuurid ning punased, rohekad, mustad värvikontrastid.
10439.de: On a yellow background, three seated female nudes painted in a sketchy manner. The left and middle figures are sitting with their right side towards the viewer. The head of the left-hand woman is turned towards her right shoulder, her gaze looking down. The woman's head and hands rest on her left bent knee, her right leg lower. The middle figure is painted in the most sketchy manner. Both of its legs are drawn up hooked under the chin. The woman on the right is in a more upright position, with her gaze directed towards the middle ground of the picture. In terms of colour scheme the painting is yellow, with black contours providing the tone, and red, greenish and black colour contrasts.

10615.de: Standing female figure in beachwear, contrapposto stance, body covered with painted flowers, beachwear marked by an unpainted dolomite surface; square base from the same stone block

Juuksed: naturaalsed inimjuuksed kapronvõrgul, lisatud koerakarvu. Valged kipsist hambad osaliselt nähtaval paokil huulte vahelt. Silikoonist mask-õõnesvorm asetseb balustri kujulisel valgel keraamilisel vaasil, mis on raskuse saavutamiseks täidetud liivaga. Keraamilise vormi alus on kaetud värvilise paberiga

The face is tinted with ready-made cosmetic powder cream, in front of the eyes ready-made plastic sunglasses with reddish frames. Hair: natural human hair on a nylon net, with dog hair added. White plaster teeth partially visible between slightly parted lips. The silicone mask hollow form rests on a balustrade-shaped white ceramic vase, filled with sand for weight. The base of the ceramic form is covered with coloured paper

11666.d: Kenus kaelaga paksude jalgadega hobusel istub neljast horisontaalsest detailist koosneval sadulal naisfiguur. Nii ratsanik kui hobune tugevalt stiliseeritud, jõulise üldmuljega. Ratsaniku pikemad juuksed katavad kõrvu ja langevad ratsutamise tuules taha, käed hoiavad hobuse lakast kõrvade juurest; hobuse massiivne saba on nurga all taha sirutatud, tagajalad harkis, esijalad toetuvad sirgelt alusele.
11666.de: On a horse with a graceful neck and thick legs sits a female figure on a saddle consisting of four horizontal parts. Both the rider and the horse are strongly stylised, with a vigorous overall impression. The rider's longer hair covers the ears and falls back in the wind of riding, her hands hold the horse's mane near the ears; the horse's massive tail is stretched out at an angle behind, the hind legs are spread apart, the front legs rest straight on the base.

11785.d: Näha neli mensuuri laste loodetega, viies, vasakus servas näha poolikuna. Paremalt esimene anum on kõige madalam. Selles kokkusurutud lapse loode. Selle kõrval teine, veidi kõrgem anum, milles terve loode nähtav. Kolmandas, veel suuremas nõus olevale lootele on tehtud kõhu piirkonda neljakandiline sisselõige, mis toob nähtavale siseelundid. Käed ja jalad on köndistatud. Vasakpoolseim on kõige kõrgem anum. Selles olevale lootele on sisselõige tehtud keha alapiirkonda.
11785.de: Four mensurae with foetuses of children can be seen, a fifth, in the left edge, can be seen partially. The first vessel from the right is the lowest. It contains a contracted foetus of a child. Next to it, a second, slightly taller vessel, in which a whole foetus is visible. 11794.d: Kaks fotot ühes raamis. FV 43/1 Ülemine foto. Paarisfotod kolmest alasti mehest ja ühest naisest interjööris.Vasakus servas istub jalg üle põlve käsi põsakil ning vasakus käes ajakirja hoidev tumedapealine alasti mees. Pea on profiilis, peas tume kähar parukas, ees tumedad päikeseprillid, süles hoiab karpi kaaluvihtidega. Naise taga paremal seisab mees, käed selja taga, pilk suunatud diagonaalselt alla - naise suunas.
11794.de: Two photographs in one frame. FV 43/1 Upper photograph. Paired photographs of three naked men and one woman in an interior. On the left edge sits a dark-haired naked man, leg crossed over the knee, hand on his cheek, holding a magazine in his left hand. Beside him stands one who leans with his right hand on a cloth-covered stand holding scales. A little further forward on the right sits a woman in an armchair, her upper body turned slightly to the left. Her head is in profile, wearing a dark curly wig, dark sunglasses in front, holding a box with weights in her lap. Behind the woman on the right stands a man, hands behind his back, gaze directed diagonally downward - towards the woman.

11795.d: Luksuslikus interjööris istub tumedas ülikonnas lühikese tumeda habeme ning vuntsidega mees. Paremale poole jääb mustrilise linaga kaetud ümmargune laud, millel seisab kinnine pudel vahuveini ja pikk klaasist vaas ühe roosiga. Mehe parem käsi toetub lauale, vasak on põlvel. Pintsaku all on hele särk ning tume lips lipsunõelaga. Mehe selja taga seisab suur pommidega kell. Paremale ja vasakule jäävad kaks suurt peeglit, milledest on aimatavalt näha ülejäänud ruumi. Parempoolse peegli ees põleb väike valge laualamp.
11795.de: In a luxurious interior sits a man in a dark suit with a short dark beard and moustache. To the right is a round table covered with a patterned cloth, on which stands a closed bottle of sparkling wine and a tall glass vase with a single rose. The man's right hand rests on the table, his left on his knee. Under his jacket is a light shirt and a dark tie with a tie pin. Behind the man stands a large pendulum clock. Two large mirrors are on the right and left, in which the rest of the room can be dimly seen. In front of the right-hand mirror a small white table lamp is burning.

11796.dm: laius: 38.3 cm (raami mõõt); kõrgus: 29.4 cm (raami mõõt)
11796.d: Kaks kõrvutiasetsevat fotot ühes raamis. FV 45/1 Siseruum  kahe tooli, kardinate ja väikese raamatukapiga. Foto paremas nurgas on näha laual lillelist lina ning taamal diivaninurka. Foto keskel istub mees. Mehel seljas kirju kampsun, jalas sinakad teksapüksid, heledad sokid ning auguga sussid. Otsevaates mehe käed nõjatuvad tooli käetugedele ning peod on süles. Ülaosas on kirjutatud "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" ning signatuur. FV 45/2 Vasakpoolsel fotol sama interjöör. Ühe tooli asemel valge kolme jalaga taburet, rohkem näha diivanit ning selle kohal olevat pilti. Foto keskel istub mees samas asendis, mis eelmiselgi, seljas roosa kleit, kaelas pärlid, süles hoia
11796.de: Two photographs side by side in one frame. FV 45/1 An interior with two chairs, curtains and a small bookcase. In the right corner of the photo a floral cloth is visible on a table and a corner of a sofa can be seen in the background. A man sits in the middle of the photo. The man is wearing a patterned sweater, bluish jeans, light socks and slippers with a hole. Facing forward, the man's hands rest on the armrests of the chair with his palms in his lap. At the top is written "Hästikirjutaja Hasso Krull aegunud Ameerika plastpaberil" and a signature. FV 45/2 The same interior in the left-hand photo. Instead of one chair there is a white three-legged stool, more of the sofa is visible along with the picture above it. A man sits in the middle of the photo in the same pose as in the previous one, wearing a pink dress, pearls around his neck, holding something in his lap

Foto keskel istub tugitoolis hallipäine, heleda särgi ja tumeda vestiga mees,  pea pöördes paremale. Parem käsi toetab lõuga, vasak põlvel. Toa põrandal kaks triibulist kaltsuvaipa, millede peal segipaisatud kortsus ja sirgeid paberilehti. Paremas servas serveerimislaud, millel paberid, tass, klaaskauss jm. esemed. Mehest vasakul väikese tabureti peal suur must kirjutusmasin.
11797.de: In an interior sits a man with glasses. In the background on the right a curtain with a wavy pattern, on the left a wall completely covered with paintings. In the centre of the photo sits a grey-haired man in an armchair, wearing a light shirt and dark waistcoat, his head turned to the right. His right hand supports his chin, left hand on his knee. On the floor of the room two striped rag rugs, on which scattered crumpled and straight sheets of paper are lying. On the right edge a serving table with papers, a cup, a glass bowl and other objects. To the left of the man, on a small stool, a large black typewriter.

Tema hoiab ülestõstetud käes valgustit, rõivastunud musta, traksid kollakas-rohekad. Mees seisab profiilis pea otsevaates.
11799.de: In the interior of a photography studio, two blonde, long-haired women sit on a small black sofa; the one on the right is wearing a blue dress and black high-heeled shoes. The girl's hands are in her lap. The one on the left is wearing a yellow dress, the young woman sits with one leg crossed over the other, wearing black lace-up boots, with one hand holding sunglasses at her forehead, the other hand in her lap. Leaning diagonally on the sofa is a man in pinkish trousers, a spotted shirt, a striped tie and a greyish hat, wearing glasses. To the right of the women stands a second man. He holds a light raised in his hand, dressed in black, with yellowish-greenish suspenders. The man stands in profile with his head facing front.
